**Scope check**
This repository is maintained as a close WotLK 3.3.5a port of upstream Cell. Feature requests here should focus on upstream behavior that should be ported, or WotLK compatibility work needed for existing Cell behavior.
Maintainer policy: if a feature does not exist in upstream Cell, it is not accepted in this WotLK port. Please propose new feature ideas upstream first at [enderneko/Cell](https://github.com/enderneko/Cell).

Please select the reason this request fits the project:
- [ ] This requests existing upstream Cell behavior to be ported.
- [ ] This is required for WotLK 3.3.5a compatibility.
- [ ] This fixes missing or broken behavior in the current WotLK port.

**Upstream reference**
If this exists in upstream Cell, link the file, commit, issue, pull request, or release note here.

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
